ns2:course.label: Honors Seminar I
ns2:course.description: (ENGL 296) Themes, Movements, and Forms in British and American Literature. May be repeated if topics vary. Offered every term with varying topics. Prerequisite: A 3.25 grade-point average or consent of the chair of the English Honors Committee. Preference to students in the English Honors program and to English concentrators.
